info.title: Encompass API
info.description: Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Read-only tokens can call every GET endpoint; write tokens can also change data.

get.description: Set the CSRF cookie and return the token for the X-CSRFToken header.

post.description: Log in and start a session.

get.description: In-progress entries grouped by media type, most recently touched first.
Most recently completed entries across media types.
Who the credentials belong to and what they can do.
Everything in progress, recent completions and reading habits.

Tracking history, newest first (status changes, progress, scores, episodes).

Pass the returned ``next_cursor`` to page further back.
Search a metadata provider (TMDB, AniList, MAL, Hardcover, ...).
Full provider metadata: synopsis, genres, cast, episode lists, page count.

List the user's tracked entries, newest activity first.

``year`` keeps entries with any activity in that year; the response lists
every year with activity so a client can offer a year picker.

post.description: Track something new, or update an entry when ``instance_id`` is given.

get.description: Return the user's entry id for a provider item, or null if untracked.
One entry with its history, watched episodes and provider metadata.

delete.description: Remove an entry (and its history) from the library.

post.description: Advance or rewind progress by one unit, using the model's own rules.

get.description: Return a show with every season and the user's progress.
Every episode of a season with air dates, runtimes and watch state.

post.description: Watch or unwatch episodes, creating the season entry when needed.

get.description: Years with any tracked activity, newest first.
Year-end snapshot: totals per type, monthly activity, finishes, reading.
Every episode with title, synopsis and still where providers have them.

post.description: Set anime progress from an episode, tracking the anime if needed.

get.description:
Cast (and key crew) of one title; fetched from the provider on first view.

For anime, ``characters`` pairs each character with its Japanese and
English voice actors. Each person carries ``also_in``: other titles in
your watched library they appear in.

People who appear in at least ``min_titles`` titles you've watched.

``role`` is ``actor``, ``voice`` or ``crew``; ``language`` filters voice
actors (e.g. ``japanese``). ``pending`` counts titles whose cast hasn't
been fetched yet (a background job fills them in).
One person: their roles in your library and other titles we know of.
Find people already in the catalog by name.

post.description: Ingest KOReader statistics; safe to resend the same rows.

get.description: Per-day pages/minutes, streaks and totals. Defaults to the last 30 days.
List reading sessions, newest first.

post.description: Log a reading session manually or from another app.

get.description: Books KOReader has reported, with pages and time read on each.
Book search results to link an unmatched document to.

post.description: Link a document to a book; past sessions and progress follow.

get.description: List the user's API tokens (never the keys).

post.description: Create a token. The key is returned once and cannot be shown again.

delete.description: Revoke a token; devices using it stop syncing immediately.

EntryIn.description: Create or update a library entry.
EntryIn.title: EntryIn

StepIn.description: Move progress one step (episode, chapter, page or 30 minutes).
StepIn.title: StepIn

EpisodesIn.description:
Mark episodes watched or unwatched.

``episodes`` lists episode numbers; ``up_to`` marks 1..up_to instead.
``all`` marks the whole season. ``date`` defaults to now.
EpisodesIn.title: EpisodesIn

AnimeEpisodeIn.description: Mark episode N watched (progress = N) or unwatched (progress = N - 1).
AnimeEpisodeIn.title: AnimeEpisodeIn

BookStatsIn.description: One book from KOReader's ``book`` table plus its new page rows.
BookStatsIn.title: BookStatsIn

KOReaderUploadIn.description: Payload sent by the KOReader plugin on suspend, close or wake.
KOReaderUploadIn.title: KOReaderUploadIn

SessionIn.description: A session reported by a client other than KOReader (e.g. Paperback).
SessionIn.title: SessionIn

LinkIn.description: Which library book a device document is.
LinkIn.title: LinkIn

TokenIn.description: A new token's label and scope.
TokenIn.title: TokenIn

TokenScope.description: What a token is allowed to do.
TokenScope.title: TokenScope
